newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - La Moderna started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - La Moderna started.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said on Tuesday it had started coverage of Mexican agribusiness company Empresas La Moderna SA de CV with a rating of near- and long-term accumulate.

-- "We are impressed with ELM's efforts to diversify its business. In particular, the company has made significant inroads in the global seed industry and is currently the largest vegetable seed company in the world," analysts Alyce Andrews and Leonard Teitelbaum wrote in a report.

-- "... We expect revenues to increase 10 percent in 1996 versus 1995, net of all 1996 acquisitions and divestitures. We are forecasting operating income to grow 19 percent as ELM divests its lower-margin businesses and improves operating efficiencies across the board."
-- They added, "We think the stock could very well trade at 11 times 1997 EBITDA, which would lead to a 12-month price objective of $22.40" per American Depositary Receipt.
-- The company's stock rose 1/8 to 18-5/8 in New York on Tuesday.
